Interface ILanguage

All Known Subinterfaces:
ILogic
All Known Implementing Classes:
ALL, AUFLIA, AUFLIRA, AUFNIRA, LIA, Logic, LRA, QF_ABV, QF_AUFBV, QF_AUFLIA, QF_AX, QF_BV, QF_EIA, QF_FP, QF_IDL, QF_LIA, QF_LRA, QF_NIA, QF_NRA, QF_RDL, QF_UF, QF_UFBV, QF_UFIDL, QF_UFLIA, QF_UFLRA, QF_UFNRA, SMTExpr.Logic, UFLRA, UFNIA
public interface ILanguage
This interface represents the functionality of an SMT-LIB language - the combination of one or more theories and various restrictions on the permitted expressions. The various checks for permitted expressions and declarations may refer to the current state of the symbol table.
Author:
David Cok
